sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the
equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be performed every month as indicated by 
M1 in the title block.

The two condensate transfer P/Ps
(2 per unit) move the collected condensate in condensate tank to condensate return header to
reboiler feed tank the Mazout day tank suction heater
drain to the day tank area condensate tank from which two condensate transfer P/Ps discharge to reboiler feed tank

The first draft initiated by eng.
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: 
 CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions

Work order must be issued and the
qualified maintenance staff should the suitable safety category

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of pump
motor

Disconnect electric terminals of
motor

The pump must be isolated by
closing delivery valves

Work to be Carried Out

Check mechanical seal for leakage, 
change the mechanical seal if needed.

Check for 
unusual noise vibration and repair the cause of the vibration by checking the 
alignment between the motor and the pump.
Check for excessive vibration.

Check 
pump discharge press received
valves.

Check for abnormal noise 
and repair the internal parts of the pump or check the motor.

Tighten all
loose
bolts.

Inspect the propeller and impeller 
and ground or clean and then make the balance if needed.

Change 
pump gasket.
